title: v0.32.0
excerpt: v0.32.0 Highlights This release features 814 commits from 363 contributors (121 new)! Structured decisions and generic parsers : the new POST /v1/systemone endpoint answers choice , noul and score questions over a structured state ( #59299 ), is served by default ( #60677 , #60696 ), and also runs on Cloudflare/clef-omni ( #61064 ), LiquidAI/d1-3B ( #60676 ) and DiffusionGemma ( #60466 ). The new hf tool and reasoning parser ( --tool-call-parser hf , --reasoning-parser hf ) reads the checkpoint's response_template , so models that ship it need no model-specific parser ( #58604 , #58602 ), in both the Python and Rust frontends ( #59005 ). Low-precision KV cache everywhere : NVFP4 KV cache now runs on SM8x and SM12x ( #46963 ), SM90 ( #60620 ) and with XQA decode on SM12x ( #60452 ), and on MiniMax-M3 sparse attention on SM100 ( #59300 ); GLM-5.x defaults to an FP8 KV cache on SM100, halving KV memory per rank with 2.3-5.5% more throughput at a 7-11% TTFT cost in the PR's benchmark ( #60140 , #60281 ); fp8_ds_mla on SM90 gives GLM-5.3-Flash up to 31% more output throughput ( #59246 ); ROCm gains the 4-bit ultraquant_4bit KV cache with about 2x the density of FP8 ( #57057 ). Model Runner V2 : a GPU n-gram speculator with variable-length drafts ( #40704 ), Elastic EP ( #53934 ), pipeline parallelism with prefill context parallelism for MLA models ( #59139 ), a stock torch.compile mode ( #59079 ), and MRV2 is now the default on ROCm with the model-specific MRV1 exceptions removed
